newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: EARLY S.AFRICAN SHARE FUTURES FIRMER ON BONDS.
newsitem.headline: EARLY S.AFRICAN SHARE FUTURES FIRMER ON BONDS.

text.p: 0718 GMT - South African share futures start slightly firmer in quiet trade helped by a stronger bond market. Gold contracts untraded but stronger bullion seen supporting.

Dealers say market still shell-shocked after Wednesday's fall and nervous ahead of Q1 GDP figure due at 0730 GMT. Market seen picking up during the day but with no major conviction. Cash market seen positive.
The all-share contract last at 6,372/80 from 6,365, the industrial contract is at 7,980/85 from 7,975 and the gold contract is at 825/38 from 828.
